HARBORVIEW PROPERTY MANAGEMENT
Notice of Lease Renewal Offer

Tenant: Odalys Brennecke-Marsh
Unit: 4C, 1187 Calder Street
Current lease ends: 31 January 2027

Dear tenant,

We are pleased to offer you a renewal of your lease for unit 4C.
The renewal term is twelve months, from 1 February 2027 to 31 January 2028.

Monthly rent under the renewal will be $2,415, an increase of $115
over your current rent of $2,300.

Parking space P-17 remains included at no additional charge.
The security deposit of $2,300 carries over and will not be increased.

To accept, sign and return the enclosed renewal form by 15 November 2026.
If we do not receive the signed form by that date, the unit will be
offered to new applicants and your tenancy ends on 31 January 2027.

A month-to-month option is available at $2,650 per month with 30 days notice.

Questions may be directed to the leasing office at extension 204.

Sincerely,
Leasing Office
